description: This file defines the Smarty Autoloader class, responsible for automatically loading Smarty's core classes and plugins, and registering the autoloader within PHP's SPL auto loading system.

classes.name: Smarty_Autoloader
classes.description: Handles autoloading of Smarty classes and plugins, and their registration as PHP SPL autoload functions.

methods.name: registerBC
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with backward compatibility, optionally prepending it to the autoload stack.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the class autoloader, defining directory paths and registering the autoload function.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Automatically loads a class file if the class name indicates it belongs to Smarty, including core classes and plugins.
